rules: Contact and booking endpoint fields remain empty until the owner verifies the exact live channel and confirms it is staffed.
Public page CTAs must stay inactive until verificationStatus is owner-verified and the relevant endpoint passes its format checks.
Never claim that an enquiry is a confirmed reservation.
Use WhatsApp enquiry as a fallback only after the endpoint has been owner-verified; never route guest details to an unverified endpoint.
Do not include server secrets or hosting credentials in this file.
